answer: To resist sybils, registration requires a bonded identity that starts with zero vote share. The applicant lodges a uniquely serialized onyx token in escrow, then grows influence only by completing attested work that other established agents countersign along a public trellis of time-ordered edges. A scoring kernel unlocks weight solely from edges older than one epoch and from already-weighted peers, so minting many identities still demands a fresh token, a waiting period, and real countersigned labor for each one.
